kai: Quick async standup — SLO/alerts/oncall follow-ups

kai: What I did: rolled forward kv-cache fix to canary (svc-cache-02), monitored tail latency overnight; no rollback needed.
kai: Blockers: small spike in "write" tail p99 at 03:40 UTC — not sure if it's noise or small config regression.
kai: Today: validate canary across regions, open a followup ticket if spike repeats, and update runbook for cache-warmup.

maria: Thanks — saw the p99 spike too. I cross-checked tracing and saw a couple of large batched requests from internal-batch-job.
maria: Can you capture a flamegraph and attach before we change thresholds?

devon: FYI there was a deploy window at ~03:30 for metrics-agent. Could be correlated. I ran a quick diff on agent config, didn't see anything obvious.

devon: Also if we end up changing alerting, let's avoid dropping the existing alerting route — want oncall to still get the page while we test new thresholds.

oncall-bot: ALERT_SUMMARY: 1x SLO_BREACH (kv-cache-tail-p99) at 2026-04-12T03:40:21Z. Pages: oncall@redwood.io. Alert history: 3 occurrences in 7d.

lee: I can take the follow-up ticket and own runbook edits. Assign to me and I'll add screenshots + playbook steps.

maria: Proposed alert tweak (for discussion):
```yaml
- alert: KVCacheTailP99
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(kv_cache_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service)) > 0.5
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "kv-cache tail p99 high"
```
maria: Maybe bump "for" to 15m and add a lower-priority duplicate for 5m to reduce churn. Thoughts?

devon: +1 to two-tier alerts. Also propose adding a short suppression window during scheduled batch jobs (internal-batch-job). We can tag metrics with job=true and skip pages.

kai: I'll grab the flamegraph and post link in this thread. Will kick off a canary run in eu-west-1 and collect logs.
kai: If the spike reproduces, creating ticket ENG-SRE-1234 and assigning to @lee.

lee: I'll start on the runbook now. Will add a checklist: how to validate cache-warmup, commands, and rollback steps.

devon: Ping me for a quick CR on the alert rule when you have a draft — I'll check suppression logic.

maria: @kai please include the trace id when you post flamegraph. Saves a lot of digging.

kai: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
__notes: single-string Slack thread; messages in chronological order; no title field per agents.md
